globalThis.comparison = (() => {
  const n=11+Number(globalThis.variant||0);
  const parent=document.createElement('div');parent.className='parent';
  const target=document.createElement('div');target.className='target';
  parent.appendChild(target);document.body.appendChild(parent);
  const sheet=document.createElement('style');document.head.appendChild(sheet);
  const results={};
  const rule=(syntax,inherit,initial)=>'@property --p{syntax:"'+syntax+'";inherits:'+inherit+';'+(initial===null?'':'initial-value:'+initial+';')+'}';
  const run=(name,registration,p,c,expected,extra)=>{
    sheet.textContent=registration+'.parent{width:200px;'+p+'}.target{width:var(--p,19px);height:0;'+c+'}'+(extra||'');
    results[name]=Math.abs(target.getBoundingClientRect().width-expected)<.001;
  };
  const px=n+'px';const base=rule('<length>',false,px);const inheriting=rule('<length>',true,px);
  run('initial',base,'','',n);
  run('specified',base,'','--p:31px',31);
  run('nonInherited',base,'--p:41px','',n);
  run('inherited',inheriting,'--p:41px','',41);
  run('explicitInherit',base,'--p:41px','--p:inherit',41);
  run('explicitInitial',inheriting,'--p:41px','--p:initial',n);
  run('unsetNonInherited',base,'--p:41px','--p:unset',n);
  run('unsetInherited',inheriting,'--p:41px','--p:unset',41);
  run('invalidNonInherited',base,'--p:41px','--p:blue',n);
  run('invalidInherited',inheriting,'--p:41px','--p:blue',41);
  run('winnerInvalid',base,'','--p:31px;--p:blue',n);
  run('importantValid',base,'','--p:31px!important;--p:blue',31);
  run('importantInvalid',base,'','--p:blue!important;--p:31px',n);
  run('substitutionValid',base,'','--q:31px;--p:var(--q)',31);
  run('substitutionInvalid',base,'','--q:blue;--p:var(--q)',n);
  run('missingReference',base,'','--p:var(--missing)',n);
  run('fallbackReference',base,'','--p:var(--missing,31px)',31);
  run('chain',base,'','--p:1in;--q:var(--p);width:var(--q)',96);
  run('absoluteInch',base,'','--p:1in',96);
  run('absolutePoint',base,'','--p:72pt',96);
  run('absoluteCalc',base,'','--p:calc(1in - 24px)',72);
  run('min',base,'','--p:min(1in,48px)',48);
  run('clamp',base,'','--p:clamp(24px,1in,48px)',48);
  run('trailingTokens',base,'','--p:31px blue',n);
  run('alternativeComplete',rule('<length> | <length>+',false,px),'','--p:31px 41px',200);
  run('literal',rule('auto | <length>',false,px),'','--p:auto',200);
  run('literalCase',rule('AUTO | <length>',false,px),'','--p:auto',n);
  run('percentage',rule('<length-percentage>',false,px),'','--p:25%',50);
  run('percentageAlternative',rule('<length> | <percentage>',false,px),'','--p:25%',50);
  run('number',rule('<number>',false,String(n)),'','width:calc(var(--p)*1px)',n);
  run('numberCalc',rule('<number>',false,String(n)),'','--p:calc(10 + 3);width:calc(var(--p)*1px)',13);
  run('integer',rule('<integer>',false,String(n)),'','--p:31;width:calc(var(--p)*1px)',31);
  run('integerInvalid',rule('<integer>',false,String(n)),'','--p:1.5;width:calc(var(--p)*1px)',n);
  for(const syntax of ['<angle>','<time>','<resolution>','<color>','<custom-ident>','<string>']) {
    const key=syntax.slice(1,-1);
    run(key+'Invalid',rule(syntax+' | <length>',false,px),'','--p:31px extra',n);
  }
  run('spaceList',rule('<length>+',false,'2px 3px'),'','width:11px;padding:var(--p)',17);
  run('spaceListValid',rule('<length>+',false,'2px 3px'),'','--p:4px 5px;width:11px;padding:var(--p)',21);
  run('spaceListInvalid',rule('<length>+',false,'2px 3px'),'','--p:4px blue;width:11px;padding:var(--p)',17);
  run('universalInitial',rule('*',false,px),'','',n);
  run('universalMissing',rule('*',false,null),'--p:31px','',19);
  run('universalInheritance',rule('*',true,null),'--p:31px','',31);
  run('missingSyntax','@property --p{inherits:false;initial-value:'+px+'}','','',19);
  run('missingInherits','@property --p{syntax:"<length>";initial-value:'+px+'}','','',19);
  run('missingInitial',rule('<length>',false,null),'','',19);
  run('invalidInitial',rule('<length>',false,'blue'),'','',19);
  run('dependentInitial',rule('<length>',false,'2em'),'','',19);
  run('variableInitial',rule('<length>',false,'var(--q)'),'--q:31px','',19);
  run('unknownDescriptor',base.replace('}', 'unknown:hello;}'),'','',n);
  run('invalidDescriptorRecovery',base.replace('}', 'inherits:invalid;syntax:"invalid <>";}'),'--p:31px','',n);
  run('lastRegistration',base+rule('<length>',false,'31px'),'','',31);
  run('invalidLastRegistration',base+rule('<length>',false,'blue'),'','',n);
  run('inactiveMedia','@media(max-width:1px){'+base+'}','','',19);
  run('activeMedia','@media(min-width:1px){'+base+'}','','',n);
  run('layerSourceOrder','@layer second,first;@layer first{'+base+'}@layer second{'+rule('<length>',false,'31px')+'}','','',n);
  run('cycleSelf',base,'','--p:var(--p)',n);
  run('cyclePair',base,'','--p:var(--q);--q:var(--p)',n);
  run('cycleInherited',inheriting,'--p:41px','--p:var(--p)',41);
  run('cycleUniversal',rule('*',false,px),'','--p:var(--p)',19);
  run('unusedFallback',base,'','--p:31px;width:var(--p,blue)',31);
  run('universalEmpty',rule('*',false,''),'','',200);
  run('wideInitial',rule('*',false,'initial'),'','',19);
  run('invalidVariableLastInitial',base.replace('}', 'initial-value:var(--q);}'),'--q:31px','',19);
  run('unlayeredPriority',base+'@layer low{'+rule('<length>',false,'31px')+'}','','',n);
  run('layerLastRule','@layer same{'+base+rule('<length>',false,'31px')+'}','','',31);
  run('commaListValid',rule('<length>#',false,px),'','--p:31px,41px',200);
  run('commaListTrailing',rule('<length>#',false,px),'','--p:31px,',n);
  run('commaListInvalid',rule('<length>#',false,px),'','--p:31px,blue',n);
  const animation='width:11px;animation:example-size 1s linear -.5s paused both';
  const keyframes='@keyframes example-size{from{width:var(--p)}to{width:80px}}';
  run('animationInitial',base,'',animation,(n+80)/2,keyframes);
  run('animationSpecified',base,'','--p:31px;'+animation,55.5,keyframes);
  run('animationInherited',inheriting,'--p:41px',animation,60.5,keyframes);
  sheet.textContent=base+'.parent{width:200px}.target{width:var(--p,19px)}';
  results.registrationAdded=Math.abs(target.getBoundingClientRect().width-n)<.001;
  sheet.textContent='.parent{width:200px}.target{width:var(--p,19px)}';
  results.registrationRemoved=target.getBoundingClientRect().width===19;
  sheet.remove();parent.remove();
  const healthy=document.createElement('div');healthy.style.width='11px';document.body.appendChild(healthy);
  results.recovery=healthy.getBoundingClientRect().width===11;healthy.remove();
  return results;
})()
